import json, statistics as st, hashlib, sys, re
from pathlib import Path
R = Path('$SPLAT_DATA/research/r-oracle/stack-vs-nht')
GiB = 2**30
SCENES = ["bicycle", "bonsai", "counter", "flowers", "garden", "kitchen", "room", "stump", "treehill"]

def rows(p):
    return [r for r in (json.loads(l) for l in open(p) if l.strip()) if r.get('type') != 'summary']

def pair(root, scene, seed):
    o = R / root / 'jobs' / f'stack-vs-nht-{scene}-s{seed}' / 'out'
    s = {r['view_id']: r for r in rows(o / 'stack-per-view.jsonl')}
    n = {r['view_id']: r for r in rows(o / 'nht-per-view.jsonl')}
    chk = dict(same_view_set=set(s) == set(n), n_views=(len(s), len(n)),
               targets_equal=all(s[v]['decoded_target_sha256'] == n[v]['decoded_target_sha256'] for v in s if v in n),
               image_sha_equal=all(s[v]['image_sha256'] == n[v]['image_sha256'] for v in s if v in n),
               dims_equal=all(s[v]['dimensions'] == n[v]['dimensions'] for v in s if v in n),
               views_hash={r['views_hash'] for r in list(s.values()) + list(n.values())},
               scorer={r['scorer_sha256'] for r in list(s.values()) + list(n.values())},
               gpu_uuid={r['gpu_uuid'] for r in list(s.values()) + list(n.values())})
    chk['views_hash'] = sorted(chk['views_hash']); chk['scorer'] = sorted(chk['scorer']); chk['gpu_uuid'] = sorted(chk['gpu_uuid'])
    m = {}
    for k in ['psnr', 'ssim', 'lpips_vgg', 'lpips_alex']:
        a = st.mean(s[v][k] for v in s); b = st.mean(n[v][k] for v in n)
        m[k] = dict(stack=a, nht=b, delta=a - b)
    # cross-check vs common-scores summary
    cs = json.load(open(o / 'common-scores.json'))
    summ = {r['arm']: r for r in cs if r.get('type') == 'summary'}
    chk['summary_psnr_absdiff'] = max(abs(summ['stack']['psnr'] - m['psnr']['stack']), abs(summ['nht']['psnr'] - m['psnr']['nht']))
    return str(o.parent.parent), chk, m, o

def memory(o):
    ser = [json.loads(l) for l in open(o / 'pair-nvml-series.jsonl') if l.strip()]
    setup = max(b for t, b, ph in ser if ph == 'setup')
    out = {}
    for arm in ['nht', 'stack']:
        a = [(t, b) for t, b, ph in ser if ph == arm]
        peak = max(b for _, b in a)
        ts = [json.loads(l) for l in open(o / arm / 'torch-series.jsonl') if l.strip()]
        tr_alloc = max((x[1] for x in ts if x[3] == 'train'), default=0)
        all_alloc = max(x[1] for x in ts)
        gaps = []
        for i in range(1, len(a)):
            g = a[i][0] - a[i - 1][0]
            if g > 1.0:
                lvl = max(a[i - 1][1], a[i][1])
                near = (peak - lvl) / GiB <= 1.0 or (15 - (lvl - setup) / GiB) <= 1.0
                ins = [x for x in ts if a[i - 1][0] < x[0] < a[i][0]]
                info = dict(t_into_arm_s=round(a[i - 1][0] - a[0][0], 2), gap_s=round(g, 3),
                            nvml_before_gib=a[i - 1][1] / GiB, nvml_after_gib=a[i][1] / GiB,
                            level_minus_setup_gib=(lvl - setup) / GiB, near_peak_or_guard=near)
                if near:
                    res = [x[2] for x in ins]; al = [x[1] for x in ins]
                    before = [b for t, b in a if a[i - 1][0] - 2 <= t <= a[i - 1][0]]
                    after = [b for t, b in a if a[i][0] <= t <= a[i][0] + 2]
                    info.update(n_inproc_samples_inside=len(ins),
                                reserved_range_gib=[min(res) / GiB, max(res) / GiB] if res else None,
                                reserved_span_gib=(max(res) - min(res)) / GiB if res else None,
                                allocated_range_gib=[min(al) / GiB, max(al) / GiB] if al else None,
                                allocated_span_gib=(max(al) - min(al)) / GiB if al else None,
                                nvml_2s_before_gib=sorted({b / GiB for b in before}), nvml_2s_after_gib=sorted({b / GiB for b in after}),
                                peak_minus_setup_gib=(peak - setup) / GiB)
                    info['admissible_historical-build-043'] = bool(len(ins) >= 10 and (max(res) - min(res)) / GiB < 0.25
                                                      and a[i - 1][1] == a[i][1] and (15 - (peak - setup) / GiB) >= 2)
                gaps.append(info)
        out[arm] = dict(setup_gib=setup / GiB, nvml_peak_gib=peak / GiB, nvml_minus_setup_gib=(peak - setup) / GiB,
                        torch_train_alloc_peak_gib=tr_alloc / GiB, torch_whole_alloc_peak_gib=all_alloc / GiB,
                        n_nvml=len(a), max_gap_s=max(a[i][0] - a[i - 1][0] for i in range(1, len(a))), gaps_over_1s=gaps)
    # registered guards: training torch peak from result files as well
    sr = json.load(open(o / 'stack' / 'result.json'))
    out['stack']['true_peaks_train_alloc_gib'] = sr['true_peaks']['phases']['train']['torch_max_allocated_bytes'] / GiB
    out['stack']['memtrim_training_max_alloc_gib'] = sr['memtrim']['training_max_alloc_gib']
    out['stack']['whole_process_torch_peak_gib_reported'] = sr['whole_process_torch_peak_gib']
    nr = json.load(open(o / 'nht' / 'row.json'))
    out['nht']['row_peak_vram_gb'] = nr.get('peak_vram_gb'); out['nht']['row_eval_peak_vram_gb'] = nr.get('eval_peak_vram_gb')
    for arm in ['nht', 'stack']:
        x = out[arm]
        tr = x.get('true_peaks_train_alloc_gib', x['torch_train_alloc_peak_gib'])
        wp = max(x['torch_whole_alloc_peak_gib'], x.get('whole_process_torch_peak_gib_reported') or 0, tr)
        x['guard_a_pass'] = tr <= 15; x['guard_b_pass'] = x['nvml_minus_setup_gib'] <= 15; x['whole_torch_pass'] = wp <= 16
        x['whole_process_torch_used_gib'] = wp
        near = [g for g in x['gaps_over_1s'] if g['near_peak_or_guard']]
        x['gap_letter_invalid'] = bool(near)
        x['gap_amended_ok'] = all(g.get('admissible_historical-build-043') for g in near)
    # health
    txt = (o / 'nht' / 'child.log').read_text(errors='replace').replace('\r', '\n')
    rel = [int(m.group(2)) for m in re.finditer(r'Step (\d+): Relocated (\d+) GSs', txt)]
    nf = nr.get('oracle_health', {}).get('final')
    sh = sr.get('oracle_health', {})
    sd = [d for d, n, c in sh.get('densify', [])]; sf = sh.get('final')
    health = dict(nht=dict(peak=max(rel) / 2e6, late=rel[-1] / 2e6, final=(nf['dead_lt_0p005'] / nf['count']) if nf else None, n=len(rel)),
                  stack=dict(peak=max(sd) / 11e6, late=sd[-1] / 11e6, final=(sf['dead_lt_0p005'] / sf['count']) if sf else None, n=len(sd)))
    return out, health

def verdict(seed_means, scene_deltas, vgg):
    mu = st.mean(seed_means); sd = st.stdev(seed_means); pos = sum(1 for d in scene_deltas.values() if d > 0)
    if mu > 2 * sd and pos >= 6 and vgg <= 0: v = 'AHEAD'
    elif abs(mu) <= 2 * sd: v = 'PARITY'
    else: v = 'BEHIND'
    return dict(seed_means=seed_means, mean=mu, sd=sd, two_sd=2 * sd, scenes_positive=pos, n_scenes=len(scene_deltas), dvgg=vgg, verdict=v)

res = dict(room={}, v2={})
for s in [54, 55, 56]:
    d, chk, m, o = pair('x5v21', 'room', s)
    mem, h = memory(o)
    res['room'][s] = dict(dir=d + f'/stack-vs-nht-room-s{s}', checks=chk, metrics=m, memory=mem, health=h)
for sc in SCENES:
    if sc == 'room': continue
    for s in [45, 46, 47]:
        d, chk, m, o = pair('x5v2', sc, s)
        res['v2'][f'{sc}-s{s}'] = dict(dir=d + f'/stack-vs-nht-{sc}-s{s}', checks=chk, metrics=m)

def combined(slots):
    seed_means = []; vgg_means = []
    per_scene = {sc: [] for sc in SCENES}; per_scene_vgg = {sc: [] for sc in SCENES}
    for k in slots:
        ds = []; vs = []
        for sc in SCENES:
            r = res['room'][54 + k] if sc == 'room' else res['v2'][f'{sc}-s{45 + k}']
            ds.append(r['metrics']['psnr']['delta']); vs.append(r['metrics']['lpips_vgg']['delta'])
            per_scene[sc].append(ds[-1]); per_scene_vgg[sc].append(vs[-1])
        seed_means.append(st.mean(ds)); vgg_means.append(st.mean(vs))
    sd = {sc: st.mean(v) for sc, v in per_scene.items()}
    out = verdict(seed_means, sd, st.mean(vgg_means))
    out['vgg_seed_means'] = vgg_means; out['per_scene_dpsnr'] = sd; out['per_scene_dvgg'] = {sc: st.mean(v) for sc, v in per_scene_vgg.items()}
    return out

room_seed = [res['room'][s]['metrics']['psnr']['delta'] for s in [54, 55, 56]]
res['room_summary'] = dict(dpsnr=room_seed, mean=st.mean(room_seed), sd=st.stdev(room_seed),
                           dvgg=[res['room'][s]['metrics']['lpips_vgg']['delta'] for s in [54, 55, 56]])
res['combined_primary'] = combined([0, 1, 2])
res['combined_letter'] = combined([0, 1])
json.dump(res, open(sys.argv[1], 'w'), indent=1, default=str)
